scalars.scalar_value: 3-5 years clinical experience in a Women's Health environment

items.item_text: Basic Life Support - CPR
3-5 years clinical experience in a Women's Health environment
Utilizes the nursing process to identify and meet the needs of the patients.
Identifies changes in patient's condition and intervenes appropriately.
Provides patient care for a given patient assignment, either as a primary caregiver or by delegating and supervising as a team leader.
Works collaboratively with physician. Reviews orders. Reports abnormal lab values and significant changes in patient findings.
Works collaboratively with patients and family to establish a plan of care, which would include an assessment of psychosocial needs.
Complies with all mandatory reporting requirements.
Graduation from an accredited school of Nursing
Registered Nurse: CA
Demonstrates a caring, compassionate attitude toward others.
Relates with patients/visitors empathetically and tactfully.
Reacts calmly and efficiently in emergencies.
Collaborates and provides leadership with patient-care team.
Maintains effective relationships with coworkers and medical staff.
Demonstrates ability to work within a team model of patient-care delivery.
Demonstrates proficient basic nursing skills and specialty skills.
Demonstrates knowledge of the nursing process and the ability to apply these principles appropriately.
Demonstrates ability to organize and prioritize work efficiently.
Demonstrates clear, effective written and oral English skills, and objective active-listening skills.
Demonstrates ability to delegate appropriate patient care tasks, duties, etc. to other team members.
Ability and willingness to actively participate in process improvement activities.
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work with others across all departments.
Ability to communicate effectively in oral and written English and Spanish, clearly, concisely and accurately.
